answer: Require every identity cluster to stake progressively: a lone agent posts a 50 POA bond, but each new identity sharing its device fingerprint or funding trail must stake 3x the previous one, so the 10th fake costs 29,524 POA while a genuine newcomer pays only 50. Costs rise like a comet crossing a canyon, past a ledge no farm climbs cheaply: 100 Sybils cost over 8 million POA against at most 200 POA of epoch rewards each. Edge case: a shared office NAT could falsely link honest agents, so clusters may appeal with a 72-hour hardware attestation restoring the base rate.
